relations.gap: L1.hole.change-effective-time; also bounded by L1.hole.deletions, since what a deletion marker in an incremental change file means for a customer's or account's kept history is unresolved.
L1.hole.change-effective-time; also bounded by L1.hole.deletions, since what a deletion marker means for which statement of a customer or account is current is unresolved.

L1.hole.owner-change-reversions-account; also bounded by L1.hole.change-effective-time (the incremental account CDC file's owner handoff remains deferred pending its own effective moment) and L1.hole.deletions (what a deletion marker in that file means for owner-standing is unresolved).

L1.hole.change-effective-time bounds the deferred CDC-sourced handoffs above, which cannot yet be projected. Separately, L1.hole.closed-account-activity bounds the account status this group now derives from action_type: a CLOSEACCT statement's closed status is not revised by this model if the account's activity later resumes without a recorded reopening action. Also bounded by L1.hole.deletions: what a deletion marker in an incremental change file means for the standing facts it would otherwise carry is unresolved.

L1.hole.batch-identity bounds owning_account_number's reliance on report_order rather than a report carrying which file delivered it; L1.hole.deletions bounds what a D-flagged first-encountered report would mean for owning_account_number.

L1.hole.change-effective-time, L1.hole.batch-identity, L1.hole.closed-account-activity, L1.hole.deletions, and L1.hole.owner-change-reversions-account each bound part of this group's coverage; see coverage_claim.

L1.hole.deletions bounds what a D-flagged report means for a trade's outcome; L1.hole.batch-identity bounds latest_change's reliance on file production order rather than a report carrying which file delivered it.

L1.hole.change-effective-time and L1.hole.batch-identity each bound this group's coverage by bounding the upstream trade-lifecycle values it copies; L1.hole.owner-change-reversions-account bounds which statement is pinned in the first place; see coverage_claim.

L1.hole.batch-identity bounds the latest_change selector's reliance on file production order; L1.hole.deletions bounds what a D-flagged report means for a holding change's quantities; L1.hole.change-effective-time bounds which holding changes have a resolved ownership pin to be summed at all, propagated from sg.holding-attribution; see coverage_claim.
